svg.title: Methodology flowchart for estimating healthcare accessibility in Casablanca
svg.desc: Four-row diagram showing Dataset, Theories and Methods, Process, and Results layers for the Casablanca public transport accessibility project

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the CasaBus route dataset?')
sendPrompt('What healthcare facility data is used?')
sendPrompt('What spatial analysis methods are used?')
sendPrompt('What accessibility theory underpins this work?')
sendPrompt('How are population origin points generated?')
sendPrompt('How is the transport network graph built?')
sendPrompt('How are stops linked to routes and facilities?')
sendPrompt('How is walking time to stops calculated?')
sendPrompt('How are transit travel times computed?')
sendPrompt('How is the accessibility score defined?')
sendPrompt('How does the 2SFCA method work here?')
sendPrompt('How are origin scores aggregated to districts?')
sendPrompt('What are the final outputs of the project?')
